benchmarkMethodology.quote: The internationally recognised benchmark price for gold delivered in London; Set twice daily (at 10:30 and 15:00 London UK time) in US dollars per troy ounce; Administered independently by ICE Benchmark Administration (IBA).
benchmarkMethodology.use: Methodology context only. No current LBMA numeric price was obtained or used in the calculator.
